title: Interference and radio-quality contract pre-change baseline
worktree_note: Concept 4G.2 receiver-noise changes were already present and intentionally preserved; no Concept 4H.1 production changes were present when this artifact was captured.

canonical_optimization.result: pass; baseline and optimized propagation-only metrics matched the stored canonical values

existing_interference_path_before_change.raw_propagation_output: received_power_dbm existed only inside the link-budget/propagation result; feature properties did not expose it as a named carrier-power quantity
existing_interference_path_before_change.serving_selection: strongest eligible RSRP; no explicit serving-cell override or selection metadata
existing_interference_path_before_change.co_channel_rule: channel_id equality only; adjacent-channel/selectivity and frequency/bandwidth mismatch reasons were not exposed
existing_interference_path_before_change.power_sum: co-channel reference-resource powers converted to mW, multiplied by configured load, and added linearly
existing_interference_path_before_change.thermal_noise: kTB at the serving SCS bandwidth plus request noise figure; kept separate from receiver sensitivity
existing_interference_path_before_change.serviceability: RSRP >= -110 dBm AND SINR >= 0 dB AND RSRQ >= -20 dB

canonical_six_cell_28ghz.noise_semantics: per-RE thermal noise from SCS plus request noise figure; separate from receiver sensitivity

controlled_fixture_contract_before_chang.different_channel: excluded from interference, but only visible through aggregate behavior
controlled_fixture_contract_before_chang.explicit_weaker_serving: not representable through the request/API contract
controlled_fixture_contract_before_chang.receiver_sensitivity: strict carrier admission gate, independent of SINR denominator
